GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.poison: Corrosive effect: the target takes +50% damage from physical sources and Arcana magic.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.antiheal: The target cannot be healed or revived while it lasts.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.burn: On fire: loses 1d6 HP (fire damage) once per turn for 3 rounds. Tested attribute: Resilience.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.frost: −1 movement and −1 AC per stack (up to 4). At 5 stacks it becomes Freeze; with no new stacks it ends after 3 rounds.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.freeze: Frozen: cannot act for one round. Takes double physical damage once, which ends Freeze.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.paralysis: 40% chance to lose the action when moving or attacking with a weapon. Removed after 3 rounds.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.blind: −10 physical Precision: more likely to miss weapon attacks and sight-based tasks.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.knockdown: Knocked to the ground: must spend an action to stand up.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.knockup: Thrown into the air: loses the move action and the normal action until the end of its next turn.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.soak: Soaked: +1d Electricity damage (Charged deals 2d6 per stack, consuming Soak); with Freeze, doubles Frost stacks and physical damage is 3× (consumes Soak); −50% Heat damage and immune to Burn (consumes Soak).
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.sneeze: Sneezing fit: 40% chance to lose the action when casting spells (once per round). Lasts 3 rounds.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.sleep: At 3 stacks the target falls asleep: cannot act, but wakes up when damaged. While asleep it recovers 5 HP and 1 Mana at the start of its turn.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.confuse: Disoriented: cannot make opportunity attacks while it lasts.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.charged: Each stack charges the target; at 3 stacks it takes 3d8 electric damage. Stacks vanish after 3 rounds if they do not reach 3. Getting wet removes the stacks and deals 2d6 per stack.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.curse: The target weapon damage drops to 1d + attribute. If it is not Undead, it also takes −2 Precision.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.wildness: Becomes a beast: Discipline is halved and the lost amount becomes a Strength bonus.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.slow: Slowed time flow: the target loses its quick action.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.bleeding: At 3 stacks, takes 3d8 piercing damage on the last region hit and the stacks are removed.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.chained: Cannot move more than 3 meters from what holds it, until the chain is destroyed or released.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.venom: Takes +100% of all immediate damage and received healing drops to 0, for 3 rounds.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.bomb: A heat mass grows until it explodes: severe Heat damage to the target and nearby targets, spreading the effect.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.petrify: Turned to stone: cannot act until the effect is removed or 3 rounds pass. Gains 100 temporary HP.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.bio: Zeroes resistance to negative effects: if a negative effect has a chance to happen, it happens; stacks are maximized (or +2 if there is no maximum).
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.rust: The metal weapon rusts: when rolling damage with it, every die shows 1.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.silence: A bubble of absolute silence: the target cannot use spells.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.stun: Stunned: cannot take its standard action until the end of its next turn.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.forget: Forgets who it is: cannot use abilities, techniques or spells while it lasts.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.fear: Cannot act offensively against what it fears nor move toward it. Ends when it takes any damage.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.charm: Follows its new master orders; ends if an order puts its own life in danger. Does not work on Boss or Elite Boss enemies.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.nightmare: The target Mana drops to zero the moment it receives the effect.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.impeto: Gains one more turn in the round, right after the caster turn ends.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.darkness: At 3 stacks, takes 10 necrotic damage (permanently removes max HP); the stacks and negative effects are removed.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.imortal: While it lasts, the target cannot drop below 1 HP.
GRANBLUE.EffectsDesc.radiance: Half of all damage taken since it was applied, until the start of the next upkeep, is taken again.
